prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on cash flow and the balance sheet: free cash flow is 5.8% of the market value, a solid cash return. Also in its favour: return on capital employed is 15.6%, a strong return on the money in the business; profit grew 46.7% a year on average over three years; and profit covers interest costs 10.0 times over. Other areas on this side: the balance sheet, risk, what the price asks for the earnings.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores only 16 of 100 against the comparison pool. Also against it: the share price is 18.5% lower than a year ago; over the past year the share did 16.3 percentage points worse than the Nifty 50; and profit fell 26% compared with a year earlier. Other areas on this side: growth.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 9 points in favour and 4 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 57 of 100. The side that carries most weight is cash flow and the balance sheet. That gives an educational rating of Overweight with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
